findings.comment: Property boundary linetype is inconsistent across plan sheets. Sheet 9 (Site Plan) depicts the property boundary as a heavy dash-dot line, while Sheet 11 (Grading Plan) depicts it as a solid line. Property boundary linework must use consistent symbology throughout all discipline sheets.

Easement line types are not adequately defined in the plan legend. Multiple distinct easement types are depicted on the plans (Drainage Easement, Wastewater Easement, Water Easement, Electric Easement, Telephone Easement, Sidewalk Easement) but the legend defines only a generic 'Easement' symbol with '-PUE-' linetype. Each easement type shown on the plans must have a distinct, defined linetype in the legend.

Right-of-Way boundary symbol is not included in the plan legend. UCM 2.5.1.E.9 requires that all boundary elements including ROW boundaries be defined in the plan legend with appropriate symbol and linetype designations. The legend must include a distinct ROW boundary symbol.

applicableAreas: Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan Sheet 5
findings.comment: The Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Recorded Instrument 2010070731), a perpetual no-build easement covering 0.31 acres in the NE interior of Lot 1, is not depicted as delineated linework on any site plan sheets. This recorded easement must be shown with delineated boundaries on all applicable plan sheets per UCM 2.5.1.E.11 requirement to show all existing infrastructure within the Limits of Construction.

Street address for each building structure is not shown on the Austin Water utility plan sheet. Buildings 1-8 are identified only by building number and unit numbers on Sheet 19 (Utility Tap Plan), but no street address is visible for any building. Per UCM 2.5.1.E.14, the street address for all structures must appear on the lot where the structures are located on Austin Water utility plan sheets.
